description: Localisation des bornes de Recharge pour Véhicules Électriques (IRVE) is a dataset listed in Cachan open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Cachan. Ce fichier est proposé par la ville de Cachan. Il permet de géolocaliser les emplacements des bornes de recharges des véhicules électriques. Coverage: Cachan. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are ELECTRIQUE, VOITURES, BORNES. The portal shows 7 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-08-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cachan-portal.
